sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
 equipment inspection 
steps I1, which must be performed 
every 6 months as indicated by M6 in the 
above title block.
Pump function is to:

a) 
 Transfer of clear water to chair coal filter.

b) 
 Transfer of acid water to anion.

c) 
 Transfer of demi water to make up water tank.

d) 
 Transfer of drinking water to drinking water tank.

The first draft is initiated & tested by eng.
 Ibrahim 
 Ahmed Ibrahim, reviewed by 
maintenance director eng. Mohamed El Amshety, accepted by eng. Abd El Shafy Ali 
general director, revised by EDEC inspection and quality control eng. Samir abd 
El Gelil, approved by eng. Deyaa Yousif head sector of Ataka power station (2x300 + 2x150) MW, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa El-Lethy EDEPC inspection 
and quality control head sector.
Technical Specification
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Use safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Use safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery
valve.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, suitable lifting device
Manual puller, feeler gauges.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Check any noise for vibration.
Check any leakage from the piping connection to the pump.

Check the leakage from stuffing box and prevent it by retightening the gland 
bolts.
Check leakage of lubricating oil from bearing house.
Check the oil level.
Check the pressure in pump delivery.
Check the temperature of bearing house.

items: Check any noise for vibration.
Check any leakage from the piping connection to the pump.

Check the leakage from stuffing box and prevent it by retightening the gland 
bolts.
Check leakage of lubricating oil from bearing house.
Check the oil level.
Check the pressure in pump delivery.
Check the temperature of bearing house.

sections.text: After Isolating the Pump (mechanically and electrically)
Check the coupling pins.
Change the packing if there is more leakage.
Prevent the leakage of lubricating oil.
Add lubricating oil to pump to level less than 2/3 side glass.
Retighten the bolts connected to the pump and motor with foundation.

items: Check the coupling pins.
Change the packing if there is more leakage.
Prevent the leakage of lubricating oil.
Add lubricating oil to pump to level less than 2/3 side glass.
Retighten the bolts connected to the pump and motor with foundation.

sections.text: Return Pump into Service

items:
Operate the pump by coordination 
 with the shift engineer.

Ensure that the pump is OK, check the 
 direction of rotation, record the 
 readings of pressure, temp., vibration, according to the technical 
 specification table at introduction, and compare with the previous reading.
